calls.reason: OpenAI's April 2025 system card reports large hallucination rates for o3 and o4-mini on SimpleQA and PersonQA. Google's May 2025 RAG study finds hallucinations persist even with retrieval. Together these show the risk was real and ongoing.

OpenAI's benchmarks show factual errors, but they predate the June window and don't test consistency on ordinary facts. Nothing in the packet addresses whether ChatGPT has a stable internal model, which is half of the claim.

Vafa et al. tie incoherent world models to failures only on narrow structured tasks. Anthropic traces some hallucinations to a misfiring answer-or-decline circuit. Neither shows world models explain errors broadly across the cited categories.
